reply.rationale: No defensible multi-entry compositional paradigm survives the evidence requirements. The only suggested family, CFA/CFT, shares surface CF and a broad meaning component ('cool cloth, then fan ...'), but there is no independent evidence that CF is a reusable morpheme, nor that final A and T form a stable substitution class with corresponding meaning contrast in the same frame. T is independently glossed as 'top face', which does not match CFT's 'two faces', and A is not independently supported at all. Elsewhere, repeated letters/digits (e.g. 1-14, DC/DCE, FB/FBF) behave like opaque mnemonic or indexed whole procedures rather than compositional pieces with literal recurring contributions. The standalone face symbols (T, B, L, R, Fr, Bk) and intensity symbols (g, f) do declare semantic dimensions, but no supplied multi-symbol code can be segmented with predictable whole meaning from those parts under the required paradigm test. Therefore the safest analysis is a flat lexicon.
